body:
## Root cause

Labyrinth Complex (`Labyrinth2Level`) runs **11 warm ceiling `PointLight2D`s** at energy 0.7-0.85 across every zone (`scripts/levels/labyrinth2_level.gd:255-284`), plus window lights and a scene-wide `DirectionalLight2D`. With a floor base colour of `(0.17, 0.15, 0.13)`, those steady lights already push the floor pixels close to saturation in the main play areas. A muzzle `PointLight2D` pulse of `+4.5` energy in ADD blend produces almost no perceptual delta on already-bright pixels — but the same pulse **doubles** the brightness of unlit `Sprite2D` decals (blood, particles, casings), which is why the owner kept seeing the flash on decals but not on the floor.

Earlier fixes (floor `ColorRect → Polygon2D`, `light_mask = 3` on floor/walls/cover, `range_item_cull_mask = 3` on the muzzle light) didn't change the outcome because the light *was* reaching the floor; the floor just already had so much warm light on it that the pulse was imperceptible.

## Fix

Add a dedicated additive `Sprite2D` (`FloorGlow`) to `MuzzleFlash.tscn` that fades on the same ease-out curve as the `PointLight2D`. Because `Sprite2D` + `CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD` bypasses the 2D lighting system, the glow is visible on every floor regardless of the map's ambient lights — the same mechanism that already makes blood decals and casings light up.

All previous environment-level changes are reverted: `Labyrinth2Level.tscn` and `LabyrinthLevel.tscn` now match `origin/main`, the `PointLight2D` returns to `energy = 4.5, texture_scale = 4.5` without `range_item_cull_mask`/`blend_mode` overrides — honouring the owner's "верни яркость вспышки как в ветке backup" request.

## Changes

- `scenes/effects/MuzzleFlash.tscn` — new `FloorGlow` `Sprite2D` with an additive `CanvasItemMaterial`
- `scripts/effects/muzzle_flash.gd` — animate `FloorGlow` alpha with `FLOOR_GLOW_START_ALPHA = 0.9` and `FLOOR_GLOW_SCALE = 2.5`, share the existing ease-out fade with the `PointLight2D`
- `tests/unit/test_muzzle_flash.gd` — cover the new constants, the alpha fade, and a regression assertion that the glow is clearly visible during the first third of the flash
- `docs/case-studies/issue-1845/` — record the new root cause analysis plus the latest owner log (`game_log_20260420_125552.txt`)
- Revert the Labyrinth/Labyrinth2/MuzzleFlash scene-file edits from earlier attempts

## How to verify

1. Open `Labyrinth Complex` (`Labyrinth2Level`).
2. Fire any weapon — an orange glow should flash on the floor under the muzzle at every shot, while the `PointLight2D` continues to light the walls and cast shadows through existing `LightOccluder2D` geometry.
3. The flash should look the same on other maps (`ArenaLevel`, `BeachLevel`, `BuildingLevel`, …) — the new glow is additive and small enough not to disturb existing flash visuals on darker floors.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#1845

commits.messageBody:
The previous fixes tried to make the muzzle flash's PointLight2D visible on
the Labyrinth Complex floor by changing the floor to Polygon2D, adding
light_mask bits, and bumping energy/texture_scale. Owner kept reporting
"floor still dark" because the real cause is that the map's 11 warm
ceiling PointLight2Ds already saturate the floor, so a pulsed +4.5 energy
ADD blend produces almost no perceptual delta on already-bright floor
pixels. Blood/particles/casings appear to flash because those start
unlit so the same +4.5 addition doubles their brightness.

Fix: add a FloorGlow Sprite2D child to MuzzleFlash.tscn with an additive
CanvasItemMaterial and a radial gradient. It fades on the same ease-out
curve as the PointLight2D and guarantees the flash is visible on any
floor regardless of the map's ambient lighting — the same mechanism that
already makes blood decals and casings light up in the owner's
screenshots.

- scenes/effects/MuzzleFlash.tscn: add FloorGlow Sprite2D
- scripts/effects/muzzle_flash.gd: animate FloorGlow alpha
- tests/unit/test_muzzle_flash.gd: cover FLOOR_GLOW_START_ALPHA and fade
- Revert the Labyrinth/Labyrinth2 scene-file edits from earlier attempts;
  the scene files now match origin/main
- Keep LIGHT_START_ENERGY at 4.5 per owner's "verni yarkost' kak v
  backup" feedback
- docs/case-studies/issue-1845/: record new root cause and latest log
commits.messageHeadline: Add additive FloorGlow sprite to muzzle flash for visible floor flashes

commits.messageBody:
… before texture edge

With ADD blend mode, near-zero alpha pixels still contribute visible colour,
making the 128x128 GradientTexture2D appear as a square instead of a circle.
The gradient now fades to alpha=0 at offset 0.7 (well inside the square's
edge midpoint at 1.0), texture size increased to 256x256 for smoother
falloff, and scale adjusted 2.5->1.25 to maintain the same ~320px visual
glow diameter. Also added missing owner game logs to case study.

title: Make muzzle flash visible on Labyrinth Complex floor via additive sprite
